brand_notes: Triangle (France) Borea line; BR03 is the larger Borea standmount (16 cm), front-ported, 25 mm EFS silk dome with diffuser; claims 90 dB, measures about 87 dB; 4.2 Ω minimum. Heavy YouTube/reviewer promotion noted by ASR members. BR02 (13 cm, $469) has only maker data (3.6 Ω min, 89 dB claimed).
takeaways: LW ±2.3 dB (EAC) / ±2.1 dB (ASR), f3 57 Hz; port and crossover resonances 500 Hz-4 kHz
Min impedance 4.2 Ω, EPDR 2.2 Ω: below-iec flag
EAC: high distortion (about 2.2% at 86 dB, about 8% at 96 dB, graph-read); compression under 3 dB through 102 dB
Pro reviewer (What Hi-Fi?) enthusiastic; ASR and Erin unimpressed
conflicts: Pro praise of treble vs measurement-based criticism
